body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Cresyn(www.cresyn.com), a Korean head/ear phone manufacturer, expects to launch its high-end headphone 'Phiaton MS 400' in North America. Boasting its sensitive red color design, the Phiaton MS 400 will be available on September 1st.
(Picture: Park Tae-hwan, who wins an Olympic swimming gold medal in the men's 400-meter freestyle at Beijing Olympic Games, is wearing Cresyn's headphone ' Phiaton MS 400')
Meanwhile, the company had unveiled its premium brand 'Phiaton' at CES 2008, to penetrate global market.
